securityMfa_controllerConfirmOwnerPresen.en: Verify your identity once before unlinking the passkey
securityMfa_controllerConfirmOwnerPresen.zh: 解绑 Passkey 前先验证一次身份

securityMfa_passkeySheetBuild.en: The passkey is kept by this device's system; the login service only records its public key. On a new phone, a passkey synced through the same system account gets you back in.
securityMfa_passkeySheetBuild.zh: Passkey 由这台设备的系统保管，登录服务只记下它的公钥。换手机后，用同一个系统账号同步过去的 Passkey 就能再次进入。

securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetConf.en: The device verifies your identity once before unlinking. The passkey stored in the system is managed by the system; LOOP can't delete it, the login service just stops accepting it.
securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetConf.zh: 解绑前设备会先验证一次身份。系统里的那份 Passkey 由系统管理，LOOP 删不掉它，只是登录服务不再认它。

securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetConf.en: After unlinking, this way back is gone
securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetConf.zh: 解绑后这条路就没有了

securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetEmpt.en: Once linked, this device's face or fingerprint is a separate way back in.
securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetEmpt.zh: 绑定后，这台设备的面容或指纹就是一条独立的回来路。

securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetEmpt.en: This account has no passkey yet

securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetUnkn.en: No response from the login service yet
securityMfa_passkeySheetPasskeySheetUnkn.zh: 还没有读到登录服务的回答

securityMfa_passkeySheetText.en: The login service hasn't responded during this session yet.
securityMfa_passkeySheetText.zh: 这次运行还没有得到登录服务的回答。

securityMfa_sheetBuild.en: Both methods are kept by the login service. LOOP doesn't store the secret key or the passkey.
securityMfa_sheetBuild.zh: 两种方式都由登录服务保管，LOOP 不保存密钥，也不保存 Passkey。

securityMfa_sheetBuild2.en: Once turned off, the login service won't ask you for a code when it requires two-step verification.
securityMfa_sheetBuild2.zh: 关闭后，登录服务在要求二次验证时不会再问你验证码。

securityMfa_sheetCancelled.en: System verification didn't finish. Nothing was changed.
securityMfa_sheetCancelled.zh: 系统的验证没有完成，这次什么都没有改变。

securityMfa_sheetDeviceUnsupported.en: This device has no passkey available; the system offers no place to create one.
securityMfa_sheetDeviceUnsupported.zh: 这台设备没有可用的 Passkey，系统没有提供可以创建的地方。

securityMfa_sheetInvalidCode.en: The code is wrong or has expired. Enter it again.
securityMfa_sheetInvalidCode.zh: 验证码不对或者已经过期，重新输入一次。

securityMfa_sheetLoopLabel2.zh: 验证器给出的 6 位码

securityMfa_sheetLoopPasskeyDomainPendin.en: LOOP needs domain credentials for passkeys first; this version doesn't have them yet
securityMfa_sheetLoopPasskeyDomainPendin.zh: 还要先给 LOOP 配好 Passkey 用的域名凭据，当前版本还没有

securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetFailureTitle.en: The login service hasn't enabled MFA yet
securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetFailureTitle.zh: 登录服务尚未开启 MFA

securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus.en: On · Passkey. When the login service requires two-step verification, the system shows a passkey prompt.
securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus.zh: 已开启 · Passkey。登录服务要求二次验证时，会让系统弹出 Passkey 验证。

securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus2.en: This account already has a passkey; you can also use it for two-step verification.
securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus2.zh: 这个账号已经有 Passkey，可以直接把它也用作二次验证。

securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus3.en: Create a passkey on this device and use it as your two-step verification method.
securityMfa_sheetMfaSheetPasskeyStatus3.zh: 用这台设备创建一个 Passkey，并把它作为二次验证方式。

securityMfa_sheetNotAuthenticated.en: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and retry.
securityMfa_sheetNotAuthenticated.zh: 登录状态已经失效，重新登录后再试。

securityMfa_sheetNotEnabled.en: The login service hasn't enabled MFA yet. This isn't a problem with this device or your account.
securityMfa_sheetNotEnabled.zh: 登录服务尚未开启 MFA。这不是这台设备的问题，也不是你账号的问题。

securityMfa_sheetPasskeyDomainUnconfigur.en: LOOP needs domain credentials for passkeys first; this version doesn't have them yet.
securityMfa_sheetPasskeyDomainUnconfigur.zh: 还要先给 LOOP 配好 Passkey 用的域名凭据，当前版本还没有。

securityMfa_sheetS.en: An authenticator app generates 6-digit codes on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Scan the code or enter the key with it. The key is issued by the login service; LOOP doesn't store it.
securityMfa_sheetS.zh: 验证器 App 是手机上生成 6 位验证码的应用，例如 Google Authenticator、Microsoft Authenticator、1Password。用它扫码或输入密钥即可。密钥由登录服务签发，LOOP 不保存它。

securityMfa_sheetUnavailable.en: Can't reach the login service right now.
securityMfa_sheetUnavailable.zh: 暂时联系不上登录服务。

securityMfa_sheetUnknown.en: Didn't finish; the login service gave no reason.
securityMfa_sheetUnknown.zh: 没有完成，登录服务没有说明原因。
